requirements.name: Complete rank9 cure-category and protection/dependency contract
minimumFields: For each corruption category identify the source-qualified eligible state, exact terminal mutation/callback, affected scope and preserved records: ordinary Corrupted, other tagged active sources, numeric corruption/exposure, KT knowledge/stages, PT current stages/history, and distinct symptoms.

Specify intrinsic/protected source handling and any exact authority needed to remove a source; no high-rank bypass or automatic wholesale inheritance of lower Purge exclusions. Preserve the stronger permanent all-corruption promise instead of substituting minor-only cleanse or a few-point reduction.

Define parent/child teardown and stable once-only dependency handling. A symptom/child ending does not prove its remote cause ended; source-owned active changes and completed anatomy/HP/Wounds/death/memory/history/custody must remain distinct.
Retain the current Null Veil exclusion and three named purge routes. No fourth purge, erasure of knowledge or blanket KT/PT cure follows from a Corruption label.
requirements.established: Sources distinguish these categories and provide bounded lower-rank examples; Souls/Research8 expressly supplies no Purification procedure. Null Veil boundaries are explicit, not an unresolved permission to invent a fourth route.

requirements.name: Creature/environmental admission and finite occupied geometry
minimumFields: Complete the separate willing-creature and environmental-area modes, with exact target eligibility, perception/line-of-effect and paid hidden-state evaluation. State how hidden creature occupants are admitted; willingness for a visible primary creature is not permission to cure every hidden occupant.

Authorize an exact useful bounded shape/extent and inclusion rule, with occupied bodies/volumes, boundary contacts and obstruction. Native120feet is reach, not radius or unlimited extent; borrow neither Cleanse10foot geometry nor Purge20foot sphere.

Specify divisible intersections, indivisible required extents, protected portions, outside remnants and remote generators. Record persistent cleaned-region provenance and exact surviving source identities/clocks so redrawing an old region cannot recreate a completed removed application.
requirements.established: Area-or-creature and120foot reach are native; selected separate modes/willingness remain proposed. Lower-rank geometry and save procedures are specific to those spells, not a rank9 grant.

requirements.name: Permanent completed cure versus Until Dispelled lifecycle
minimumFields: Preserve the selected completed permanent-removal result and the unchanged native Until dispelled field side by side. Provide an explicit authorized reconciliation identifying precisely what ongoing operation, if any, remains dispellable, or an explicit field interpretation if none remains. No residual ward or extra benefit is invented to fill the mismatch.

Define actual dispel/suppression/ending settlement and source identity. A completed removed corruption application is not restored by dispelling the cure under the selected direction. Surviving protected/uncured sources retain actual deadlines and resources.

Distinguish genuinely new authorized exposure/reapplication from revival of the same removed application. No blanket future immunity, grace period, knowledge erasure, healing/resurrection, resource refill or retrospective history reversal.
requirements.established: Completed removal is the retained direction; it is not a sealed resolution of the duration conflict. The Core duration remains verbatim Until dispelled and no new continuing ward is selected.

minimumIntegratedWitness.minimumNextAction: Supply one explicitly authorized Purification-only W01/W02/W03 contract, then the creature and multi-source area witnesses below. No unchanged two-component replay is required.

encounters.required: A source-qualified willing creature with actual corruption/source/protection/dependency records; legally acquired native caster, paid26baseRP/final-cost cast, useful completed cure and exact surviving state, including applicable protected/KT/PT/Veil boundaries. No fictitious target or imported cure result.

A useful paid multi-source area cure in the authorized geometry, with actual hidden/admitted occupants, divisible/indivisible/protected portions, remote dependency extents, outside remnants and persistent cleaned-region provenance; genuinely new exposure and an actual legal dispel/ending settlement under W03.

sharedRequiredState: Complete profiles/acquisition/prepared routes and lawful components/range/Action; actual final RP, Dissonance/Refrain, Ready/Reaction/Counterspell history where relevant.
Source/application IDs, exact current corruption categories, actual body/area geometry, protections and parent graph; no remote expansion by inference.

All before/after states, original deadlines and budget/resource/custody histories, forward/inverse operations and independent semantic checks. Numerical reversibility alone is not useful spell completion.
minimumIntegratedWitness.authorshipBoundary: Missing mechanics need explicit scoped authorship; actual source/actor/corruption/area facts require their own authority. This request does not authorize inventing cure or area rules or campaign histories.

wholeSpellGateReason: The unresolved categories, extent and continuing/end semantics define the native permanent area/creature cure itself. Lower-rank successful removal examples and review-gate components cannot satisfy that positive promise.
absenceScope: Missing from this exact reviewed bound set, not a claim that the content cannot be authored or that no evidence exists elsewhere.
